verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB gives agents their own authentication path: MCP access uses OAuth 2.1 rather than API keys (docs-7). It also documents least-privilege mechanisms, including roles scoped down to table and column (docs-24) and isolated read-only compute for agents (docs-12). The evidence never explicitly ties these together into a way to issue scoped, per-agent credentials. Missing for 10: documented issuance of per-agent scoped tokens or credentials, explicit OAuth scope or permission controls for MCP clients, revocation and expiry of agent credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
